title: Kimi K3 matches Fable 5 at a third of the price
dependency_review: Inspected the imports and runtime reads of all three kimifable generators. gen/kimifable_gen.py (YouTube split), gen/kimifable_cutout_gen.py (TikTok cutout) and gen/kimifable_whiteboard.py (Instagram whiteboard) share gen/kimifable_scene.py and import pipeline/captions.py, pipeline/pointing_cues.py, formats/cutout/lib/{cutout_core,cutout_depthfield} and formats/whiteboard/lib/{whiteboard_build,whiteboard_fix6_core}; both lib directories are shipped whole (they carry their own envelope, pill-width and cap-width JSON). The cutout generator also puts F/format_lab/_shared on sys.path but imports no module from it, so that scratch directory is deliberately not shipped. Resolved runtime file reads, all included: plans/kimifable_plan.json (the single geometry contract for the three lanes), cuts/kimifable (master.mp4, audio.m4a, face_full_hd.mp4, face_bottom_hd.mp4, edl.json, transcript_tight.json), prep/kimifable.json and the prep/stages/kimifable.* stage records, gen/_envelope_kimifable.json, gen/_cues_kimifable.json, gen/_wb_kimifable.json, gen/_pillwidths.json, gen/_df/bandframes_kimifable.json, gen/_build_kimifable{,_cutout}.json, the _geom and _geomstrict paperwork, plus gate1, prerender, qcpass, rc, rcspec, phonepage and birefnet records, and the matting session JSONs the cutout lane reads (plate.json, selection.json, matting.json, ship_v5.json) with measure.json, edits.json, chair_prompt.json and selection.mask.png for context. Raw media: the untouched Filmed recording /Users/migle/Movies/2026-09-04 13-46-50.mp4 (831 MB) and its full ASR transcript intake/transcripts/2026-09-04 13-46-50.json; the tight transcript ships inside Cut. Project assets: kimifable_split/assets and kimifable_cutout/assets are real directories with no symlinks inside, and kimifable_whiteboard/assets is a symlink to shorts_run17/stage/kimifable_whiteboard that the packager must materialize. Every local src and href in the three index.html files resolves inside its own asset tree: logos kimi, claude-color, claude, deepseek, gemini-color, grok, mistral, openai, qwen; music bed.mp3 and bed_split.mp3; sfx click, pop, whoosh, tick, low_thump, page_turn, pen_soft3, reverse_air, soft_whoosh; v/voice.m4a, v/audio.m4a, v/face_bottom_hd.mp4, v/face_band.mp4 and the cutout matte.webm and matte_rim.webm, which are real copies of the v5 mattes rather than links, with their .src pointer files alongside. External runtime dependencies, not vendorable: GSAP 3.14.2 from cdn.jsdelivr.net and Google Fonts Poppins, Nunito and JetBrains Mono, loaded by all three compositions; rendering needs the HyperFrames CLI pinned at 0.7.107 plus ffmpeg and ffprobe, and the generators run on the Workspace venv Python with numpy and Pillow. Excluded on purpose: matting plate videos and matting-cache, review probe sheets, and every unrelated recording. No secrets. Hashes verify the copies only; no end-to-end rebuild was run.
